races.title: State House, District 117
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Lynne Russo
cands.bio: Communications consultant who has owned her own consulting business for about 23 years, working with nonprofit and education organizations. She lives in Hendersonville and organized Hurricane Helene relief fundraising. She has not held elected office. She won the NC House District 117 seat in 2026 as a Democrat.
cands.gaps: We found no record of any elected office or legislative service for Lynne Russo, so there are no votes or official actions to report. We could not find where in Minnesota she was born or raised, or the year she moved to North Carolina. We found no statements from her on immigration or H-1B, foreign or out-of-state land buying, policing, guns, abortion, or teacher pay. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements. Her Ballotpedia page lists only two voting-group recommendations.

local.label: Roots 20: She says she did not grow up in North Carolina and moved to Hendersonville as an adult after the pandemic, so she has lived in the state well under 10 years.

stop-data-centers.evidence: Her campaign site says she will stand up for affordable power and families, not corporate data centers and other projects that drive up energy demand and utility bills. It also calls for transparency and local input before large data centers are approved. It does not call for a statewide ban or for state preemption of county approvals.

end-homestead-tax.evidence: Her campaign site proposes a Senior Homestead Refund that returns half of property taxes, up to $1,200 a year, to eligible seniors. This is limited relief for seniors, not elimination of homestead taxes.

slow-growth-protect-land.evidence: Her campaign site pledges to restore local control over zoning and development, protect farmland, and balance growth with protecting water and open space.

school-choice-teachers.evidence: In her Ballotpedia survey she pledged to fully fund public schools and push back on the diversion of $1.3 billion in taxpayer dollars to private school vouchers.

cands.name: Chelsea Walsh
cands.bio: Chelsea Walsh is a Republican who ran for the North Carolina House in District 117. She lost the 2022 Republican primary to Jennifer Balkcom. In 2026 the state Republican Party chose her to replace Balkcom as nominee, and she lost the general election to Lynne Russo (D).
cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Chelsea Walsh was born or raised, or when she moved to North Carolina. We found no record of her job history or education. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, and we found no campaign website or platform statements. We found no stated positions from her on data centers, development, property taxes, immigration, guns, abortion, schools, policing or other issues. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for her in 2026. She has held no public office, so there are no official actions to report.
